_about: Mods managed by the SpaceBourne 2 Realism installer. 'switches' are config.lua keys set to true when the mod is ticked; 'state' lines are rewritten in the mod's saved toggle file so a ticked mod always starts active.

mods.name: Hardcore Tactical Realism (HTR)
mods.desc: Realistic combat and AI: caliber vs armor, hit zones, wounds, faction doctrines.

mods.name: Split Controls
mods.desc: Separate look inversion for ships and on foot, gamepad and mouse.

mods.name: Silent Ops
mods.desc: Realistic stealth: suspicion, noise, suppressors, silent takedowns.

mods.name: Gear Without Levels
mods.desc: Use any weapon or suit at any level, with small realistic penalties.

mods.name: Faction Power
mods.desc: Dungeons, strategic sales and missions earn your faction power.

mods.name: Tactical Engineering
mods.desc: Deployable turrets that take time to set up, with limited ammo.

mods.name: SB2 HOTAS (optional)
mods.desc: Joystick, HOTAS, pedals, head tracking, triple screen. Installed by its own bridge app.
